headline: KUSKA Residence / Taller MACAA (Misión de Arquitectura, Construcción y Arte en los Andes)
context: With the goal of migrating to an environment completely opposite to the city, Kuska was born—a Quechua word meaning "together." The space was conceived as the primary residence for a writer and an artisan, while also designed to host friends, family, and artists-in-residence.
